1.2.1.summary: The UI polish release: Lucide icons everywhere, Win11-style toolbars and status bar, a phase-aware loading banner with a learned ETA, a semantic DSP sparkline, Everforest themes, and a UI regression harness that keeps the fixes from sliding back.
highlights: Lucide everywhere: every app icon is now Lucide (ISC), recolored to the active theme; the FontAwesome/Nerd-Font glyphs and system-theme icon lookups are gone, and vendored icons are one `scripts/fetch-lucide.sh` away.

Compact Win11-style chrome: main toolbar, canvas toolbars and status bar rebuilt with flat tiles, square icon containers, borderless checked states with inverted icon ink, themed tooltips and keyboard focus rings.

Phase-aware loading banner: Engine → Plugins → Canvas → Session chips, one segment per pipeline step with an in-segment shimmer, format badges, a learned per-plugin ETA from stored load statistics, and a smooth height animation on show/dismiss.

Semantic DSP sparkline: autoscaled to the visible range, colored per point by standard deviation (green calm, yellow warn, red spike), configurable window from Settings, with current/average readout in a fixed 2-inch block.
Xruns with context: an activity ring records what preceded each xrun, the chip is colored semantically and clicking it opens the report with an explicit Clear action.
Everforest Dark and Everforest Light join the builtin themes, and a surface-elevation pass separates background, surfaces and hovers so the UI stops reading as one flat shade.
The canvas minimap lost its header, floats its controls inside the map and docks to the top or bottom of the rack list; buffer size and sample rate are changeable from the status bar.
changes: Icons: getIcon() resolves Lucide first with theme icons as fallback; glyph texts replaced in rack slots, toolbars, canvas node buttons, settings and menus.

Toolbars: Win11 command-bar styling, square tiles with equal min/max (the QSS box model was squashing buttons to 28x22), context toolbar in pure box-model autolayout, search field unclipped, and the bar can never leave the canvas.

Status bar: rebuilt flat with muted labels, borderless combos, accent scrollbars, per-pixel rack scrolling and the right group flushed to the edge; Xruns typography matches the labels and the chip is a clickable QLabel.

Loading: the legacy ProjectLoadingDialog is sunset (session offer prompt renamed ProjectSessionOfferDialog); the banner fixes the silent setPipeline(0) bug that disabled segments, and the old dialog fallback crash is gone.
ETA: per-plugin load durations are stored as exponentially weighted averages in QSettings and matched against the project's plugin plan; the first load seeds the stats.
Exit: programmatic quits never prompt, and the redundant clean-quit confirmation is off by default (unsaved-changes prompt stays).
Minimap: headerless with floating grip/collapse/menu buttons, dockable to the rack list, with observable state restore (QSafeSettings type-arg fix).

Rack: hint-driven modernized slice, SVG ghost-paint fix on knobs and LEDs, badge/policy minimum-width fixes (slot minimums 281 -> 222px), right-overflow fix via viewport-fitted item widgets, and semantically colored LED traffic lights with a crossfade.
Themes: surface-elevation pass separates background/surface/hover in every theme; light themes no longer invert when the mode argument is omitted.

claramsg: shot takes semantic targets with automation (plugins opens UIs, settings opens the dialog, context-toolbar selects nodes), rack detail dumps LED/dial geometry, status reports a code_version stamp and warns when the running instance predates the code on disk.
Tests: test_polish_contract.py (theme QSS must never override requested widget sizes) and the rack layout harness gains slot minimum-height/width guards.
Sunset: legacy FontAwesome glyph texts, the old project loading dialog, and dead canvas theme/LED code paths.

1.2.0.summary: One theme for the whole UI, real node shadows, nested Carla-Patchbay projects that load and save correctly, and a scriptable control channel for testing.
highlights: Unified theming: one app theme now drives the rack, the patchbay, dialogs and settings; theme switching settles in ~0.55 s on a 25-plugin project (was ~5.5 s).
Clara Light rebuilt as a soft-grey theme with high-contrast text, calmer borders and an Apple-style label colour, replacing Catppuccin Latte.
Node shadows that behave: real drop shadows, zoom-aware blur/offset, spread/distance/opacity controls and a keep-shadows-while-dragging toggle, previewed live.
Nested Carla-Patchbay projects fixed (upstream #1715): chunks were decoded twice and saved empty; three nesting levels now load, save and round-trip intact.

Scriptable UI: claramsg can screenshot, drive the settings dialog, zoom/report the canvas, list and target instances, wait for readiness, quit cleanly, and open plugin UIs, including nested plugin hosts.
Generic bridged LV2 state restore: custom data is applied before a single state:restore, fixing sfizz and LSP plugins alike.
Autosave no longer fails with "Failed to write file", and nested plugin windows no longer add duplicate tray icons.
changes: Theme engine: the global QSS uses Qt palette roles instead of compiled colour literals, so a theme change swaps the palette and repaints only the visible top-level windows.
Rack: slots restyle in place instead of being rebuilt, take dark/light from the app theme, and the list itself paints no background so it inherits the theme surface.
Patchbay: node fill, header, text, outline, shadows, ports, cables, selection, rubberband, grid dots, drag ghosts, containers and role badges all resolve from the app theme.
Port labels now refresh on theme change instead of keeping cached pens; canvas state reports the resolved theme colours for testing.
Drop shadows: translucent black instead of the canvas background colour, offset and blur scaled with zoom, plus container shadows.
Settings: the separate Canvas theme selector is gone (the canvas follows the app theme), the Patchbay page is grouped into Nodes, Cables, Node shadows and Rendering, and shadow changes preview live.
The stored "Node drop shadows" flag is enforced again, and shadow spread/distance/opacity plus the drag toggle are copied into the live canvas options on Apply.
Nested projects: chunk values are decoded exactly once, the stored XML prolog/DOCTYPE is skipped, empty states are ignored, and a failed load keeps its stored state on save.
Bridged LV2: custom-data messages are applied even while a plugin is disabled, then one state:restore runs after the batch; sfizz stores raw absolute instrument paths.
Autosave: the .autosaves/<project> folder is created before the backend writes, fixing the "Failed to write file" dialog.
Tray: only the standalone app owns a tray item; nested plugin and control instances skip it.
claramsg: new shot, settings, canvas, instances, wait, quit and plugin ui commands, with --instance targeting and pid-scoped sockets for nested plugin hosts.
scripts/ui_smoke.py launches a scratch instance and checks shadows, zoom, screenshots, theme switching and clean shutdown.
Performance: plugin edit dialogs are built lazily (18.8k -> 7.2k widgets) and SVG images are parented to their owner instead of becoming top-level widgets.
Tests: theme colour-literal lint, text/background contrast, settings key hookup, project-storage round-trip, JSON round-trip, and the UI smoke script.
Clara Light replaces Catppuccin Latte; a saved theme that no longer exists falls back to Catppuccin Macchiato, and every bundled theme is selectable from the registry.

1.1.8.summary: JSON project files written directly by the engine, accurate patchbay signal flow, honest load progress and safer session saves
changes: Project format: .carjp is written and read by the engine itself (no temp XML), and new saves default to .carjp while .carxp stays fully supported
Session safety: a failed save no longer clears the dirty flag or deletes autosaves; a failed load keeps the current session; XML and autosave writes are atomic

Patchbay: ports that arrive before their client group are queued, reused client ids no longer inherit filtered state, and cable pulses follow the real source level (fixed pw-record container, rate and node-id targeting)
Load: containers and saved positions are applied before plugins load, the progress dialog reports real plugin/phase progress, and the rack paints in place
Shutdown: SIGTERM always quits, with a 4 s watchdog if a plugin bridge hangs
Tests: project-storage round-trip, JSON document round-trip and pw-record sampler checks now run in CI

1.1.7.summary: Patchbay layout containers (VBox, HBox, Grid, Freeform), collapse cable rerouting to header slots, interactive resizing, transparent inline rename, and contextual toolbar integration
changes: Layout Containers: backdrop layout groups (VBox, HBox, Grid, and Freeform) placed behind patchbay nodes without reparenting cables or altering port coordinates
Zero-Drift Child Anchoring: child nodes anchor strictly to container origin with grid-snap bypassing to eliminate coordinate drift and de-centering
Collapse Cable Rerouting: collapsing a container re-anchors all child input and output cables to proxy header slots so connections stay visible and cleanly routed to the group
Interactive Header & Resizing: draggable header in normal cursor mode, direct clickable header buttons (collapse, ungroup, layout switcher), and corner/edge resize handles with dynamic sizing cursors
Transparent Inline Rename: double-clicking the container header or choosing Rename launches a seamless inline text editor powered by native QGraphicsTextItem (preventing Qt6 proxy widget crashes)

Contextual Toolbar Integration: dedicated [GROUP] options on the floating toolbar (rename, layout mode switcher, color swatch picker, collapse/expand toggle, ungroup) and batch 'Group Selected Nodes into Container' action
Catppuccin Palette Bar: horizontal color swatch bar with 10 Catppuccin presets, quick reset button, and native color dialog for both nodes and containers
Project Persistence: full XML and JSON serialization/restoration of container definitions, layouts, and standby ghost descriptors across session save and load cycles
Stability: fix right-click context menu event dispatch in PatchScene and prevent accidental canvas panning when clicking containers

1.1.6.summary: Patchbay performance overhaul: QOpenGLWidget hardware acceleration, item caching, 60fps animations, and fast wire previews
changes: Hardware Acceleration: migrate canvas viewport from deprecated QGLWidget to modern QOpenGLWidget via qt_compat.py with safe runtime fallback
Migration: enable Canvas/UseOpenGL by default and add automatic one-time config migration for existing users
Viewport Updates: enable SmartViewportUpdate alongside DontAdjustForAntialiasing and DontSavePainterState optimization flags to eliminate full-canvas repaints
Item Caching: enable DeviceCoordinateCache on CanvasBox, CanvasPort, and CanvasIcon items so static nodes, badges, and icons bypass redundant repainting
Signal Pulses: bump signal flow animation clock to 60 FPS (16ms interval) for fluid visual pulses
Wire Dragging: render instantaneous straight-line previews during active mouse dragging with a settle timer to transition to bezier curves when paused

1.1.1.summary: Stability and reliability patch: stops Cardinal crash-on-load, fixes the Add Plugin dialog selecting the wrong plugin, persists the plugin cache across restarts, collapses startup recovery into a single prompt, and makes the program filetype-agnostic with extensions owned solely by the save manager
changes: Cardinal (and other GLX/KV-Element/JUCE-UI) plugins no longer crash the host on load: they are auto-loaded in bridge mode when a project contains them
Add Plugin dialog: the Rack and Cards views now stay in sync with the (custom-sorted) table, so adding a plugin no longer inserts an unrelated one
Plugin list cache now includes LV2 and internal plugins and is pruned of stale entries, so a restart no longer needs a full rescan
Startup shows a single last-save/autosave recovery prompt instead of two back-to-back dialogs; recovered sessions load the autosave content under the last-saved name and path

Project filetype handling is now filetype-agnostic: the program works with filenames plus an opaque format tag, and only the save manager knows extensions (legacy .json projects remain loadable but stay out of file dialogs)

1.1.0.summary: Rich CLI startup banner and Ctrl+C prompt, plus tag/version consistency enforcement across the release pipeline
changes: CLI startup now renders a rich panel showing `Clara vX.Y.Z` followed by `based on Carla version A.B.C` (with Python/Qt/PyQt and path details); `--version` uses the same banner, with a plain-text fallback when `rich` is unavailable
The terminal Ctrl+C (SIGINT) prompt is now a rich panel: pressing Enter quits (default) and T keeps Clara running in the system tray

Release pipeline now enforces tag/version consistency: `scripts/check_version.sh` and a CI `version-check` job block a tag whose version does not match `base_version`/`releases.json`, and the release checkout uses `fetch-depth: 0` so the AUR `pkgver` bump fast-forwards cleanly
`scripts/release_and_push_aur.sh` now also bumps the internal `base_version`, preventing builds from self-reporting a stale version to the in-app updater

Plugin list: on-demand viewport rendering replacing bulk card/row allocation, fixing search/filter desync and the initial scroll jump, greatly reducing cold-start cost
Rack, canvas and statusbar refinements: flexible statusbar/toolbar layout for half-screen tiling, rack width/defocus stability, and reduced log-flood UI stalls

Graph introspection model (patchcanvas/graph_info.py) as the foundation for scripting/claractl
Major canvas performance pass: multi-second freeze on settings apply with pure-Python routers cut to a few hundred ms
Catppuccin theming across patchbay, settings and search; sidebar tabs and buttons use Nerd Font glyphs, legacy bitmap icons/options removed
Modal (Photoshop/Blender-style) canvas navigation, infinite canvas, marquee selection and minimap tracking
Session safety: rotating autosaves, countdown timers, dirty-edit tracking and save-on-exit prompts
New distribution targets: portable x86_64 AppImage and Flatpak builds (clara primary, carla kept as a backwards-compatible symlink)

Added manual 'Check for Updates...' option to the Help menu and toolbar menu with immediate feedback
Updated .github/FUNDING.yml including falkTX upstream sponsorship links alongside Clara maintainer
Modal ProjectLoadingDialog with animated marquee progress bar and real-time status updates
Modernized About screen: streamlined layout, removed legacy bitmap logos/fonts, and added repository & sponsor links
Patchbay camera autofocus: smooth 260ms pan-only navigation with InOutCubic easing curve
Fixed rack item delete confirmation modal across Delete/Backspace hotkeys and right-click context menu
